cleanup_commands_for_manual_review:
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash
run_case() {  # $1 = label, rest = launch args
  label=$1; shift
  log=/tmp/scan_watch_v3_launch_$label.log
  setsid ros2 launch scan_watch_v3 monitor.launch.py "$@" >"$log" 2>&1 &
  pgid=$!
  echo "=== $label: ros2 launch ... $* (pgid $pgid)"
  for i in $(seq 1 50); do timeout 5 ros2 node list 2>/dev/null | grep -q scan_watch_v3 && break; sleep 0.2; done
  timeout 10 ros2 node list
  timeout 10 ros2 param get /field_v3/scan_watch_v3 limit
  if [ "$label" = explicit ]; then timeout 10 ros2 topic info -v /field_v3/scan | grep -E 'Node name|Endpoint type|Reliability|Durability'; fi
  timeout 30 python3 /tmp/scan_watch_v3_probe.py /field_v3
  kill -INT -- -$pgid; for i in $(seq 1 30); do kill -0 -- -$pgid 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done
  kill -0 -- -$pgid 2>/dev/null && { echo "forcing stop"; kill -KILL -- -$pgid; }
  grep -E 'Counting|ERROR|Traceback' "$log"
}
run_case explicit namespace:=field_v3 limit:=0.83
run_case default namespace:=field_v3
timeout 5 ros2 node list

ps -o pid,pgid,sid,args -g 141578,141655 --sid 141578,141655 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-140
for g in 141578 141655; do kill -INT -- -$g; done
for i in $(seq 1 30); do kill -0 -- -141578 2>/dev/null || kill -0 -- -141655 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done
